subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text :
stimulus: hi Jhorna, Im coming to Bangladesh next month Will you receive me at the airport said Meghla. Dont worry Ill be there Jhorna said. Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: "Hi, Jhorna! I'm coming to Bangladesh next month. Will you receive me at the airport?" said Meghla. "Don't worry. I'll be there," Jhorna said.  For Question No. 12, 13, 14 & 15, See Solution to Suggestions; Composition Part চ্যান্সেলর এসএসসি শটর্ সাজেশন্সের উত্তরমালা  118
